title: Miss Behavin'
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Delivery

Quest Description: Find Roh-Zee's Wardrobe on Frump's Misfortune- Level 1 and collect Roh-Zee's Leather Gloves.

Quest Reward: 6250 Gold

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: No

Tip: Roh'zee's Wardrobe is protected by two Mutant Hulks identified as Roh'zee's Assistants. After you dispatch them you will see the wardrobe in the middle of the room and find the Gloves therein.

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find Roh-Zee's Wardrobe on Frump's Misfortune - Level 1 and Collect the Leather Gloves and Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Well, hello there, Dungeon Runner. Welcome to Frump's Interdungeonal Resort, the gateway to Frump's Misfortune. Frump's Misfortune is the latest dungeon from the dungeon magnate, The Frump. The cost of this dungeon alone would bankrupt even the most wealthy, but not The Frump. He laughs in the face of bankruptcy! He is a powerful man, Dungeon Runner. One that you would be wise to get on the good side of, lest he utter his incredibly mighty power words: We Are Letting You Go Due to Cutbacks Beyond Our Control!

You are tasked with doing something that will help you gain favor with The Frump. It is something that will help you to stick out from all of the other Dungeon Runners vying for his favor. Gain enough of The Frump's favor and he will grant you the ultimate prize: the title of The Flunky, The Frump's personal squire.

The Frump has been having an intense war of words with another dungeon celebrity, Roh-Zee O'Donner. Your task is to set out and collect a leather costume worn by Roh-Zee in the smash dungeon hit: Exit to Ick Den. The Frump wants to get his hands on all pieces of the leather costume to humiliate Roh-Zee but the costume has been split into three pieces and placed throughout Upper Frump's Misfortune. Find Roh-Zee's Wardrobe on Frump's Misfortune - Level 1 and and collect the Leather Gloves. Do this and return to me, Junior Exec Ivan, here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

The Leather Gloves? You have them?! Good Lord and Lady, this thing is huge! The Frump will be pleased. You are truly helping your chances of surviving a trip to The Boardroom.

Objectives:

  • Find Roh-Zee's Wardrobe
  • Collect Roh-Zee's Leather Gloves ×1

Level range: 25–45
